sentences.text:
+ Mac.App. 928/2019 & Cm Appl.52715/2019
 National Insurance Co Ltd .....

Appellant
 Through: Mr. Manoj Ranjan Sinha and Mr.
 Vishal Agrawal, Advs.
 versus
 Prem Wati Sharma & Anr .....Respondents
 Through: Mr. Rishabh Malhotra, Adv.
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Tara Vitasta Ganju
 Order

Learned Counsel for the Appellant restricts his arguments in the present Appeal to only one issue which is that the legal representatives of the deceased who have stepped into the shoes of the owner of the vehicle could not have filed a Petition claiming compensation under Section 163A of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 [hereinafter referred to as "MV Act"] as was done, but were required to file under Section 166 of the MV Act.

Reliance in this behalf is placed on the judgment passed by the Supreme Court in case of Ramkhiladi vs The United India Insurance Company; 2020 (2) SCC 550.
2.
